newsitem.title: MEXICO: BASF inaugurates Mexico polystyrene plant.
newsitem.headline: BASF inaugurates Mexico polystyrene plant.

text.p: The Mexican unit of BASF AG inaugurated on Wednesday a new polystyrene plant in Altamira, Tamaulipas that will produce about 143,000 tonnes of polystyrene per year.
"Between 400 and 500 tonnes of polystyrene will be produced per day," BASF Mexicana president Dietz Kaminski told reporters. About half the output will be sold in Mexico, he added.
BASF Mexicana said it invested about $50 million in the plant and expected to recover the investment "in the short-term." It also plans to construct a new copolymer plant in 1998.
